title: LIS Segmentation
description: Audio segmentation project for speaker diarization and segment labeling
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Listen to the audio and segment it by speaker or topic." />
  <Audio name="audio" value="$audio" />
  <RectangleLabels name="segment" toName="audio">
    <Label value="speaker_1" />
    <Label value="speaker_2" />
    <Label value="speaker_3" />
    <Label value="noise" />
    <Label value="silence" />
  </RectangleLabels>
  <TextArea name="notes" toName="audio" rows="2" placeholder="Optional notes about the segmentation..." />
</View>
